page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.c7nex.2xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1842.09 and a multi-core score of 7750.38. In memory performance, the instance achieves a read-only cached small-block bandwidth of 421.06 GB/sec, which drops to 58.32 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Cryptographic and vector instruction capabilities are supported by hardware flags such as AVX-512 and AES, reflected in a Passmark CPU encryption score of 7300.05.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 memory-to-core ratio, this instance is designed for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. It demonstrates strong performance in specific applications, achieving 7.83 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 11.46 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. The absence of local NVMe storage and GPU hardware makes it less suitable for heavy database logging or machine learning acceleration, but it is well-suited for web serving, software compilation, and general compute workloads.
